summary: JARLE WIIK CONSULT (org. no. 995 566 842) is a sole proprietorship (ENK) based in Sandefjord, in the Brønnøysund registers since 2010-06-07. It is active with no bankruptcy or liquidation registered. Its main activity is NACE 62.100 (Dataprogrammeringstjenester); it has 0 registered employees. CEO: Jarle Wiik.

gaps.reason: Legal form ENK is normally not required to file annual accounts in Norway, so none are public.
